name: x-arcade
description: Terminal-native daily mini-games for the dead minutes while your coding agent works.

scripts.//build: esbuild bundles @x-arcade/shared straight in. It is a private workspace package, so a published CLI that merely *depended* on it would fail at install with 'not found'. No --banner shebang: esbuild already preserves the one in src/index.ts, and adding a second put it on line 2 where it is a syntax error — the package crashed on every invocation.
